miyagi.description: Beef tongue, zunda, sasa-kamaboko and seafood: a guide to the flavors of Sendai, Kennan, Kenhoku and the coast in Miyagi.

miyagi.about: A Miyagi food guide based on social posts by people who visited local eateries. Cover images are AI-created watercolor illustrations; see the embedded original posts for actual photos of the food.

miyagi:joji-tofuten-sendai.title: Sendai City's "Jogi Tofu Shop" — Sankaku-age and Rich Soy Milk
miyagi:joji-tofuten-sendai.summary: "Jogi Tofu Shop," located in Aoba Ward, Sendai City. Known for its signature triangular fried tofu—served with shichimi garlic and soy sauce while enjoying rich soy milk—it is featured in visitor posts as a spot that makes you want to eat two pieces.
miyagi:joji-tofuten-sendai.cover_alt: Watercolor-style illustration of triangular fried tofu and soy milk
miyagi:joji-tofuten-sendai.markdown:
This is Jogi Tofu Shop, located in the Jogi area of Aoba Ward, Sendai City.

The original post describes enjoying sankaku-age while sipping rich soy milk. The highlight is eating the sankaku-age with shichimi garlic and soy sauce; the visitor's impression is that it is incredibly delicious and that they always end up eating at least two pieces whenever they visit.

This restaurant is appealing for offering sankaku-age—known as a local specialty—to be enjoyed on the spot with soy milk.

You can find the restaurant's location, phone number, and business hours on Google Maps via "Restaurant Location" at the bottom of this article.

Source: [Threads post](https://www.threads.com/@azuma_wm/post/De-bZI7gdlx)

miyagi:maguro-gao-shiogama.title: Shiogama City "Maguro Senmonten Gao" — Tuna Bowl at Naorai Yokocho
miyagi:maguro-gao-shiogama.summary: "Maguro Senmonten Gao" is located in Naorai Yokocho on Kaigan-dori in Shiogama City. A specialty restaurant where you can enjoy tuna dishes such as negitoro bowls, it is featured in visitor posts as a place you'll want to visit from time to time.
miyagi:maguro-gao-shiogama.cover_alt: Watercolor-style illustration of a tuna negitoro bowl
miyagi:maguro-gao-shiogama.markdown:
This is "Maguro Senmonten Gao," located in Naorai Yokocho on Kaigan-dori in Shiogama City.

The original post describes a visit to experience a bowl unique to a tuna specialty shop. It is one of the restaurants that visitors coming for the negitoro mention as places they find themselves wanting to return to from time to time.

This is a place you'll want to stop by when you want to casually enjoy seafood in the port town of Shiogama.

You can find the restaurant's location, phone number, and business hours on Google Maps via "Restaurant Location" at the bottom of this article.

Source: [Threads post](https://www.threads.com/@laugh.rain/post/DcW8lsKEyC2)

miyagi:ramen-billy-sendai.title: Sendai "Ramen Billy" — Shio Ramen, 950 yen, 200g serving
miyagi:ramen-billy-sendai.summary: "Ramen Billy" in the Sendai area. A visitor's post describes their experience having the shio ramen (950 yen) with 200g of noodles and a light serving of vegetables.
miyagi:ramen-billy-sendai.markdown:
This is Ramen Billy, a ramen shop in the Sendai area.

The original post describes ordering shio ramen. The price was 950 yen, with a 200g serving of noodles and a request for fewer vegetables; the post is presented as one aimed at ramen lovers in Sendai and Miyagi.

Please note that since the original post does not specify which stores (or how many) were visited, please check the nearby store information on the map guide below when visiting.

You can find the store's location, phone number, and business hours on Google Maps via "Store Location" at the bottom of this article.

Source: [Threads post](https://www.threads.com/@yu_04_14/post/DSamQOPErBD)

miyagi:yamada-an-kennan.title: "Yamada-an" in Southern Miyagi — Meat-Based Chinese Cuisine for Under ¥1,000
miyagi:yamada-an-kennan.summary: "Yamada-an," featured in the southern region of Miyagi Prefecture. Known for its excellent value—offering meat-based Chinese cuisine for under 1,000 yen—it is highlighted in visitor posts as a hidden gem in the southern part of the prefecture.
miyagi:yamada-an-kennan.cover_alt: Watercolor-style illustration of meat chuka soba
miyagi:yamada-an-kennan.markdown:
This is "Yamada-an," which was described as being located in the southern area of Miyagi Prefecture.

The original post describes a visit for niku chuka (meat chuka soba). The excellent value—enjoying this bowl for under 1,000 yen—is particularly striking, and it is highlighted as a hidden gem in the southern part of the prefecture.

Please note that the original post does not provide detailed location information down to the municipality, so when visiting, please also check the restaurant information via the map directions below.

You can find the restaurant's location, phone number, and business hours on Google Maps via "Restaurant Location" at the bottom of this article.

Source: [Threads post](https://www.threads.com/@ohayo_sendai/post/DZTeo_9E_ug)

miyagi:ichimura-ni-rifu.title: Rifu Town "Jikaseimen Ichimura Ni" — Clear, Light Soy Sauce Soba
miyagi:ichimura-ni-rifu.summary: "Jikaseimen Ichimura Ni," located in Rifu Town, Miyagi District, Miyagi Prefecture. Its signature dish is light soba with a clear soy sauce broth; a large serving is priced at 1,250 yen, as featured in a post by a user introducing ramen in Miyagi Prefecture.
miyagi:ichimura-ni-rifu.cover_alt: Photo of "Pork Ramen" from Jikaseimen Ichimura Ni (thick-cut chashu, low-temperature chashu, and back fat)
miyagi:ichimura-ni-rifu.markdown:
This is "Jikaseimen Ichimura Ni," located in the Morigo area of Rifu Town, Miyagi District, Miyagi Prefecture.

The original post features a Reel showcasing the "Ichimura Ni Tanrei Soba" from the sign. A bowl with a clear soy sauce broth, the one featured was the large size for 1,250 yen.

This is a spot in Rifu Town featured by the poster, who introduces numerous ramen shops across Miyagi Prefecture.

The cover photo features the shop's "Pork Ramen." Topped with thick-cut and low-temperature chashu and back fat, it is a hearty bowl that stands in stark contrast to the light soba.

Another bowl is the "Rich Chicken Salt." The golden broth is topped with two types of chashu, menma, and green onions.

![Photo of "Rich Chicken Salt" from Jikaseimen Ichimura Ni (golden broth topped with chashu and menma)](miyagi/ichimura-ni-rifu-torishio.webp)

You can find the restaurant's location, phone number, and business hours on Google Maps via "Restaurant Location" at the bottom of this article.

Source: [Instagram post](https://www.instagram.com/reel/Ddn-o4Dppu8/)
